findings.title: [P1] Preserve tenant isolation when authorizing document reads
findings.body: Returning true unconditionally allows a user from any tenant to read documents belonging to another tenant, creating a direct cross-tenant data exposure wherever this authorization function is used.

findings.title: [P1] Restore tenant ownership check
findings.body: This previously reported defect remains open after current-source revalidation. Evidence: At current head a36327d2676b5dfc46061cb3742b1654423a825d, src/access.ts line 2 still unconditionally returns true. The full PR diff shows this replaced the tenant equality check, so cross-tenant reads remain permitted.
